proposition: Qāsim-i Anvār (d. 837/1434), Niʿmat Allāh's khalīfa and a dāʿī for the Ṣafaviyya, is said by Niʿmatullahi hagiography to have been one of Ibn Turka's companions in Cairo.

mediation.who: Ṣunʿ Allāh Niʿmatullāhī, Savāniḥ al-Ayyām, via Mufīd Mustawfī
mediation.note: Niʿmatullahi hagiography with a stake in its saint's circle
